author: rememes
body:
Ok so this time i was banned for Maintain a calm and "Pleasant atmosphere!" Now i respect this ban completely and i think the people who banned me had the rights to do it, but i also have my say.

1. When i was banned, i was given a warning the day before. I stopped, then slipped one swear word out and BOOM, permbanned. I think it should have been a kick and at max a temp ban for a couple hours, no where NEAR a perm ban.

2. "Maintain a calm and Pleasant atmosphere" How am i supposed to when Im banned? 


3. Not one time was I given a warning in chat, if you had done that I would have simply stopped and this would have never happened.
This links to bad moderating which im not going to even start on.

Even I was banned before,My Last ban was not for that reason, so why would moderators be on such a trigger finger to ban me?
IGN: Remeh_
Cheers for considering and reading

title: My Ban 2.0

replies.author: Pelpelajax
replies.body:
Hello,

I have decided to appeal your punishment, for the following reasons. Firstly, the evidence that was providided was very limit, and not that severe. Secondly, as you mentioned, a permanent ban wasn't what it deserved. Please note that this will be your final, and only chance.

Regards,
Pelpelajax, Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
